import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0130 (l : List Nat) (h : l.length ≥ 2) : (l.drop 1).drop (l.length - 2).length ≥ 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0130 (l : List Nat) (h : l.length ≥ 2) : (l.drop 1).drop (l.length - 2).length ≥ 0 := by
  have hl1 : l.length > 1 := by
    from h
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne_of_gt h (Nat.ne_of_gt h)
  have hl2 : (l.drop 1).length = l.length - 1 := by
    rw [List.drop_length, hl1]
  have hl3 : (l.drop 1).drop (l.length - 2).length = (l.length - 1) - (l.length - 2) := by
    rw [hl2, List.drop_length]
  have hl4 : (l.length - 1) - (l.length - 2) = 1 := by
    ring
  exact Nat.zero_le hl4
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0130 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0130 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0130

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0130
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0130
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
